title: Sese Plantains (Goat or Beef with Plantain Rounds and Kale)
author: Imma Adamu (Immaculate Bites)
desc: Goat or beef shank cooked until tender, then green plantain rounds simmered about 20 minutes with Maggi, crayfish and palm oil, and kale added for the last 10.
longDesc: A one-pot plantain stew the author says is frequently served in Cameroon households and across West Africa. The meat and onion are cooked until tender. The green plantain rounds go in with Maggi, crayfish and palm oil and simmer about 20 minutes, and the chopped kale is added for another 10 minutes. Salt and pepper to taste.
ingredients: 2 pounds goat meat or beef shank
steps: Cook the meat with the chopped onion until tender. The time is not printed.
Add the plantain rounds with the Maggi, crayfish and palm oil. Simmer about 20 minutes.
Add the chopped kale and cook an additional 10 minutes. Season with salt, pepper and the optional cayenne.
chefTips: The only printed cues are ‘until tender’ for the meat and the stated 20 and 10 minutes.
Add liquid as needed — the page does not give a water quantity.
Kale goes in last so it keeps its colour.
commonMistakes: Adding the kale at the start.
Skipping the tenderness check on the meat before the plantains go in.
healthBenefits: Plantain for starch, kale for greens, meat for protein.
culturalNote: The page says the dish is ‘frequently served in Cameroon households and throughout West Africa’. Cutting and peeling steps for the plantains are not described on the page.
sources: Title as printed: ‘Sese Plantains (Turning Plantains)’. Byline as printed: ‘Imma Adamu’. Published 22 Dec 2012, last update 16 Jan 2026. Yield 6. Prep 15 min, cook 50 min, total 1 h 5 min. TWO-PASS.
ABSENT: meat cooking time; water or stock quantity; salt and pepper amounts.
